rules.title: Notice time = ETD message lastUpdate; add outcomes[].reportedHoursBefore
rules.rule: Raptor 'informed' time is timeWindowMinutes = planned departure - lastUpdate of the FDM message with legState ETD whose ETD-STD >= 1 min (eds-flight-level-change-identifier steps 16/17 -> FLIGHT_DEPARTURE_DELAY; flight_changes.rs:minutes_before_departure, flight.rs:event_trigger_time). APPR: care.rs separate() drops a delay with window > 720 (12 h). EU/ASL: delay must be at/after promise window start = latest original arrival - 14 d (itinerary.rs Promise::bounded, care.rs in_window). PNR schedule changes, AACC notifications and flight_scheduled do not count. A dropped delay leaves *_delay_disruptions empty -> *_soc_flight false -> NE-03. Converter: for kind=delay set flight.reportedMinutes = (reportedHoursBefore or noticeHours)*60 (default 120); scenario_fdm.flight_messages: ETD at dep - reportedMinutes (not fixed 120) and emit only that one ETD. Use >=13 h for APPR NE-03, >=15 days (use 18+) for EU/ASL NE-03; <12 h (default 2 h) otherwise.

rules.title: Multi-segment connections must be ONE bound
rules.rule: Bounds come from processedPnr.flightItineraries[type=JOURNEY_SERVER_BOUND] position (booking/pnr.rs ~1040). SEEDS (2,1)=ZZ6GMP is a round trip: two bounds of one segment; the builder rewrites only bound 0's endpoints. A stranded leg 2 then forms its own bound (REMAINED_AT_ORIGIN) giving NE-08/EL-01 instead of NE-12/EL-05 and EL-03/EL-06, and the pair of rows NE-03+X. Fix: in scenario_build.build_one post-process every PNR version when plan has one bound with n>1 segments: flightItineraries=[{type:'JOURNEY_SERVER_BOUND',originIataCode:first.origin,destinationIataCode:last.destination,flights:[{flightSegment:{id:'<pnr>-ST-k',ref:'processedPnr.products',type:'product'}} for each seg]}], and use the same ST ids in CM correlation (it used ST-3 for seg 2 while the PNR has ST-2; product ids must match). Or choose a one-way connecting seed.

rules.title: Cancellation/delay codes must be lookup keys
rules.rule: Cancel codes: APPR_cancellation_lookup / EU_ASL_delay_code_controllability_lookup keys (AIRS ARPT RUNW COMM HOLI OPER POSI REPO RTNS EQUI FUEL HDLG ROTA PERF TECH DAMA POLI INDU WEAT CREW). 'ATC' and the default 'CNL'/'WX' map to OTHER -> ND-X01. Default when absent: OPER. Delay codes: APPR SAFETY = 03,43-47,52,69 (41 is UNCONTROLLABLE, 42 CONTROLLABLE); UNCONTROLLABLE 1,2,4,41,51,58,71-77,81-89,93,97,98.

rules.title: No-travel scenarios: no rebooking object, no boarding
rules.rule: A flight_cancelled_rebooked step replaces the SoC segment with the protecting segment, which is not the msl_flight -> soc_flight false -> NE-03 (observed in 033-035,042-046,057-059,069-073). Model 'stayed at origin' as paxEvents not_travelled (no check-in/boarding messages) on the disrupted flight, cancellation or delay as the code needs, and drop spec.rebooking. spec_to_build already skips check-in for not_travelled/no_show. Passenger flown elsewhere = boarded (leg 1) + not_travelled (leg 2).

rules.title: SoC code reachability
rules.rule: Reason order is first_matching. NE-03 (soc_flight false) precedes NE-09/10/11/14/16; a cancellation makes soc_flight true -> ELIGIBLE (EU/ASL never NOT_ELIGIBLE for it). Hence unreachable: APPR NE-14/NE-16, EU/ASL NE-09..NE-14 (10,12,13,14 not even in lookup), EU/ASL EL-02/EL-05, ND-03 (all), PE-01 (all), NE-06/NE-08 limitation, EU NE-07. Achievable stand-ins: below 2 h non-cancelled no-travel -> NE-04; operated flight, nobody boarded -> NE-03; cancel -> EL-04/06; delay>=180 no-travel -> EL-01/03. Treat the originals as expectation drift to raise with the rule owners.

rules.title: Employee / OAL employee / loyalty / SSR need PNR fields
rules.rule: booking_type from creation.pointOfSale.office.id suffix ES/OT/EP/EE/EC or special keywords STDP/STFD/STFS (eds-booking-type); OAL employee = office ending EC + keyword text starting 'SN-00000'; segments all HK/TK/RR/KL/KK. Keep the flight AC-operated or ND (STAR/OAL carrier) precedes NE-01/02. Tier: loyaltyRequests[].membership.activeTier.code (SE, E, D...; aeroplan_elite_tiers_lookup; Basic 'A*' is not elite). SSR: SPECIAL_SERVICE_REQUEST product code in soc_eligible_ssr_codes_lookup (WCHR...). Add spec fields booking.officeId, booking.specialKeywords[], passengers[].ssr[]; the converter writes them into every PNR version.

rules.title: OAL handling
rules.rule: OAL-only itinerary expecting NE-05: send no FDM delay for the OAL flight (soc_flight false; is_all_oal_itinerary reason precedes NE-03). OAL leg expecting ND-01 needs a non-Star carrier (STAR_carriers_lookup has LH UA TK LX OS TP SK SQ NH AC-partners -> ND-02) with a delay record on that leg.

rules.title: Regime by geography
rules.rule: EU/UK from LHR/CDG/FRA/BRU origin; ASL for any TLV flight; APPR for Canada. Out-of-regime rows show NE-06/NE-07/NE-X01 as 'not applicable' defaults (not a failure).
